title: Pondatti Rajyam
desc: A young man falls in love with a woman and the couple marries each other. However, things get complicated when the man starts taking care of his dead friend's young widow, making his wife suspicious.

title: Chinnavar
desc: Muthu and Veerasamy are best friends and fishermen, and Veerasamy's sister Meena loves Muthu. When a rich man asks Veerasamy's permission to marry Meena, she claims to have already married Muthu.

title: Shankar Guru
desc: A righteous man earns the enmity of his business partners when he opposes their illegal plans. However, chaos ensues when unfathomable circumstances disrupt the wellbeing of his family.

title: Ayyaa
desc: An MLA faces vengeful opposition from a slain corrupt politician's son, who creates various challenges to settle old scores.

title: Ulagam Piranthathu Enakkaga
desc: Quarter Govindan pretends to be Raja, a rich businessman who happens to be his lookalike, to execute his revenge.

title: Mahaan Kanakku
desc: Jeeva's brother-in-law ends his life after being harassed by bank officials. In order to take revenge, he uses the loopholes of the system to get justice.

title: Maharani - The Beauty Queen
desc: A young man marries a beautiful woman but never tells her about his former girlfriend. As the couple settles down, his former lover returns, complicating their relationship.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Nayagan
desc: A woman is kidnapped and held captive by a gang. Somehow, she makes a random call using a broken phone. Now, her only salvation is the person on the other end who is least interested in helping her.
